key_traits.label: Leaves
key_traits.text: Alternate, narrow oblanceolate to linear-oblanceolate, often entire to shallowly toothed near the tip.

key_traits.label: Heads
key_traits.text: Small discoid heads; female plants especially showy in fruit from the white pappus.

key_traits.label: Fruit
key_traits.text: Cypselae with conspicuous white pappus in fruit.

key_traits.label: Best field traits
key_traits.text: green shrubby habit; narrow willowlike leaves; masses of tiny heads; white pappus on female plants
